newsitem.title: JAPAN: Okinawa desulphuriser back on line at end-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Okinawa desulphuriser back on line at end-Sept.

text.p: Refiner Okinawa Sekiyu Seisei Co Ltd said on Thursday its 38,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) fuel oil desulphurisation unit will resume operations on September 27.

The refiner, which has mainly been processing Oman and Qatar Land since an accident in April, plans to start processing a blend of Arabian Medium, Upper Zakum and Oman following the restart of the unit, a company spokesman said.
The desulphurisation unit is expected to reach its full capacity by October 1, he added.
The 110,000 bpd refinery, which closed after the fire in April, came back onstream in July except for the desulphurisation facility, which was seriously damaged.
Okinawa Sekiyu is wholly owned by major refiner Idemitsu Kosan Co Ltd.
